purpose.en: Train holding your body weight on straight arms.

text.zh: 手臂伸直，肩膀往下压、远离耳朵
text.en: Lock your arms and press your shoulders down away from your ears

text.zh: 脚尖先轻点地，压肩后收膝把身体撑离地面。
text.en: Start with your toes lightly on the floor, press your shoulders down, then tuck your knees to lift off.
Hold for about three seconds, then lower your feet slowly.

commonErrors.en: Shrugging and hanging on your shoulders.

cautions.zh: 手腕不舒服时先活动一下手腕
cautions.en: If your wrists feel stiff, warm them up first.

cautions.zh: 手腕刺痛或发麻时马上停
cautions.en: Stop right away if your wrists feel sharp pain or numbness.

changes: 剂量从计时 15 s 改为按次数 3×5：动画每 8 s 压肩+收腿 1.8 s → 撑住 2.9 s → 放脚+松肩 1.7 s → 休 1.6 s
cue2/3 按动画顺序写（脚尖点地 → 压肩 → 收膝撑起 → 约 3 秒）
flags: 剂量方式改按次数（名字叫 Support Hold，spec 也注明这是演示循环而非静止计时）；若想保持计时 15 s 请定
